entries.note: The sender's consignment data, before TNT has the parcel.
TNT picking the parcel up from the sender, after the consignment data and before the first depot.
Written at each depot the parcel passes, the delivering one included.
Minutes before the delivery on the same day.
Written after a delivery round that could not use the address. The parcel stays at the depot until the recipient gives another address or collects it.
The recipient collected the parcel from the depot that held it. TNT's pickup from the sender is "We've collected your shipment".
The recipient asks for a booked delivery. A notice, not a scan: it keeps the stage the parcel had.
TNT confirms the booked delivery, also after the delivery itself. A notice, not a scan: it keeps the stage the parcel had.
